name: Taking a part-time job can help college students gain work experience and earn pocket money.
trans: 做兼职可以帮助大学生获得工作经验并挣零花钱。

name: A suitable part-time job can relieve the financial burden of the family and cultivate independence.
trans: 合适的兼职可以减轻家庭经济负担并培养独立性。

name: Through part-time jobs, students can improve their communication skills and develop a sense of responsibility.
trans: 通过兼职，学生可以提高沟通能力并培养责任感。

name: However, taking a part-time job may affect students’ studies if they cannot strike a balance between work and study.
trans: 然而，如果学生不能平衡工作与学习，做兼职可能会影响学业。

name: College students should choose a suitable part-time job instead of blindly following high-paying advertisements.
trans: 大学生应选择合适的兼职，而不是盲目相信高薪广告。

name: It is important to be cautious about online recruitment and avoid being cheated.
trans: 对网络招聘保持谨慎、避免被骗很重要。

name: Before taking a part-time job, students should ask parents and teachers for advice.
trans: 做兼职前，学生应向父母和老师寻求建议。

name: We should sign a labor contract and learn to protect our legal rights.
trans: 我们应签订劳动合同，学会保护自己的合法权益。

name: Safety must come first when students look for part-time jobs.
trans: 学生找兼职时，安全必须放在第一位。

name: Making full use of spare time to do part-time jobs can help students accumulate social experience.
trans: 充分利用业余时间做兼职可以帮助学生积累社会经验。

name: Students should not let part-time jobs affect their academic performance.
trans: 学生不应让兼职影响学业表现。

name: Only by making reasonable arrangements can we gain both money and experience from part-time jobs.
trans: 只有合理安排，我们才能从兼职中既获得收入又获得经验。

name: It is widely acknowledged that part-time jobs have both advantages and disadvantages.
trans: 众所周知，兼职既有优点也有缺点。

name: There is no denying that a suitable part-time job can help students gain practical experience.
trans: 不可否认，合适的兼职可以帮助学生获得实践经验。

name: While part-time jobs bring benefits, they may also affect students’ studies if not well arranged.
trans: 虽然兼职带来好处，但如果安排不当，也可能影响学生学业。

name: As college students, we should strike a balance between work and study.
trans: 作为大学生，我们应该平衡工作与学习。

name: Only by choosing suitable part-time jobs can we benefit from them without affecting our studies.
trans: 只有选择合适的兼职，我们才能从中受益而不影响学业。

name: When looking for a part-time job, we should be cautious and protect our legal rights.
trans: 找兼职时，我们应保持谨慎并保护自己的合法权益。
